feeds.title: Milan Urban Food Policy Pact
feeds.description: The Milan Urban Food Policy Pact is an international agreement on urban food policies signed by over 200 cities from all over the world. Stay up to date with news, insights and all that happens around the MUFPP.

feeds.title: Conosco un posto » Drink and Eat
feeds.description: Bars and restaurants, shops and workshops, exhibitions and events, but also itineraries in the city and out-of-town trips, travel, 'smart' services and lifestyle: Conosco Un Posto, the web magazine founded by Caterina Zanzi in November 2014, tells you about them one by one. Check out our tips and suggestions on the best places to visit for the mouthwatering food, fine diners, street vendors, wineries and more!

feeds.title: A Signorina in Milan
feeds.description: Jaclyn DeGiorgio is a Milan-based storyteller and local food tour guide. She loves food, natural wines, and traveling. When she's not on the road, she's usually planning her next trip. She recounts her adventures in Italy and beyond on her blog, A Signorina in Milan.

feeds.title: Milan Foodie Insider
feeds.description: My name is Serena and this blog is dedicated to two of my great passions: good food and Milan, the city where I studied and where I lived for many years. The blog contains various navigation filters: meal opportunities (breakfast, brunch, dinner), the type of cuisine (Italian, Chinese, Thai restaurants..), the neighborhoods and then a section dedicated to the lifestyle because not just food we live!

feeds.title: Wanted in Milan » Food
feeds.description: Up-to-date news and information on the Food scenario in Milan. All you need to know on the latest updates regarding eating in Milan. Wanted in Milan is a guide to residential areas, local city news, cultural events, useful contacts, and classified advertising for expats in Milan.

feeds.title: TuttoFood Milano
feeds.description: TuttoFood is the international B2B fair dedicated to food & beverage organized by Fiera Milano. Our mission is to offer a modern, expert professional overview of trends in food&beverage industry.

feeds.title: A Milano Puoi » Ristoranti a Milano
feeds.description: In A Milano Puoi, you can find the best restaurants in Milan, tried and told to let you discover the best of our city!

feeds.title: Un Biscotto al Giorno
feeds.description: I'm Monica Papagna. I am a freelance photographer who has been dealing with food for 10 years. I photograph, write and eat, both for this blog and for magazines and brands. Un Biscotto al Giorno is a blog full of sweets, travels, curiosities and experiences.
